alt: Poster: NSE and BSE closed 20 Oct 2026 for Dussehra; T+1 settlement counts working days; Monday 19 Oct trades settle Wednesday 21 Oct
text:
Markets are closed today for Dussehra, so here is a quick settlement refresher.

• NSE and BSE are closed on Tuesday 20 October 2026 for Dussehra, per Kotak Neo's NSE holiday list and market-holiday reports.
• Settlement under T+1 is trade day plus one working day; exchange holidays are not counted as working days, per Business Standard and ShareIndia explainers.
• By that rule, trades done on Monday 19 October would settle on Wednesday 21 October.
• Remaining 2026 exchange holidays listed: 10 November (Diwali-Balipratipada), 24 November (Guru Nanak Jayanti) and 25 December (Christmas), per Kotak Neo and Sunday Guardian.

Our view: holidays rarely matter for long-term investors, but they can shift when sale proceeds or purchased units show up in an account. Checking the calendar before planning a cash need is a simple habit, and exact timelines can differ by product, so confirm with the relevant platform. This is general education, not advice.
